map_info.name: Turing Machine Lab
map_info.description: The first algorithm-trajectory chamber. A lab_room wraps the turing_apparatus — conveyor belt as the tape, robot arm as the read/write head, server rack as the program, electrical panel as the state register, info screen as the live output, emergency button as HALT, exit sign as terminate. Walking the room IS executing the machine. Built 2026-05-22 as the proof-of-concept that prop arrangement = algorithm syllabus.

learning_objectives: Walk into a chamber that IS the Turing machine model
Read the conveyor belt as the tape, the robot arm as the head, the server rack as δ, the panel as q
Press the HALT button at the back to observe the machine returning a result
